name: Vilamacolum (Spain)
description: Black field charged at the centre with the white concave cross patée of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 26 May 1995 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2061 of 12 June 1995; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, black, with the rectilinear concave cross patée of the arms at the centre, its arms half the length of the cloth.

features.role: concave cross patée with arms half the length
